mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_server ( workspace_id, server_code, name, transport, endpoint_url, credential_ref, allow_private_network, status, sync_status, last_sync_at, last_error_code, last_error_summary, lock_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{serverCode}, #{name}, #{transport}, #{endpointUrl}, #{credentialRef}, #{allowPrivateNetwork}, #{status}, #{syncStatus}, #{lastSyncAt}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{lastErrorSummary}, #{lockVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
